title: The sample mean 505 g in the null distribution
caption: Under H₀ the mean of 64 bags is N(500, 2.5²). 505 g is z = 2 above, with tail area 0.0228 each side, so the two-sided p ≈ 0.0455 < 0.05: reject.
alt: Normal curve with mean 500 and SD 2.5 for the sample mean; the tail beyond 505 is shaded, area 0.0228.
